summary: Retest of TestFlight fix: CatchVideo now mounts the <video> only when actively catching (no idle overlay/video in DOM, no '-idle-' testids), preloads via fetch->blob 1.5s after game start, and falls back to the server URL on error/stall. Ran the full backend suite (83/83) and all fishing-* browser checks. Added a NEW check simulating real playback (canPlayType override + a generated WebM fixture served in place of the mp4) proving currentSrc starts with 'blob:', paused=false, currentTime>0, and the spinner disappears; Skip then closes to the reward. Two pre-existing checks ('fishing-legendary-catch-video-fallback-flow', 'fishing-mythic-catch-animation-mocked') still used the old '.invisible'-class + '<source>' child selectors from the previous (always-mounted/idle) DOM shape and failed on rerun -- rewritten to match the new DOM (plain testid now unambiguous since only the active instance is ever portal-mounted; the <video> carries 'src' directly, no <source> child) and re-verified green. One more pre-existing, unrelated assertion bug was found while re-running the full fishing suite: 'fishing-daily-limit-reached-mocked' asserted 'Daily attempts: 15/15' but the component renders REMAINING casts (limit-used), so at used=15/limit=15 the UI correctly shows '0/15' -- same remaining-vs-used wording mismatch already fixed in a different check last iteration, now also fixed here and re-verified green. 404-fallback, skip-button, screen-layout, cast-bite-reel-flow, bait-sheet, bonus-casts, collection-sheet, missed-bite and preview-app-loads all re-ran unchanged and green.
action_items: No new app bugs found this iteration. Three check artifacts were updated to match the new single-portal-mount/no-idle-DOM semantics and the long-standing remaining-vs-used attempts wording -- none are app defects, all are check-script corrections.

checks.criterion: Backend regression (no DB change expected for this frontend video-mount refactor)
checks.name: backend pytest suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q: 83 passed in 21.28s. No backend code touched by this change.

checks.criterion: Abspielpfad (simuliert): echtes Video spielt über blob: ab, Spinner verschwindet, Skip schließt zur Belohnung
checks.name: fishing-legendary-catch-real-playback-blob
checks.evidence: NEW check: addInitScript forces HTMLMediaElement.canPlayType=()=>'maybe'; page.route intercepts /videos/legendary-catch.mp4 with a 4s WebM fixture generated via ffmpeg (imageio-ffmpeg) from the real asset. Before the catch: fishing-catch-video-overlay/-video have count 0 (no idle mount). After reel: overlay visible, video.currentSrc matches /^blob:/, paused=false, currentTime>0, fishing-catch-video-loading has count 0 once playing. Skip -> fishing-legendary-catch with +250, overlay unmounted (count 0).

checks.criterion: Mit addInitScript canPlayType + Route-Mock spielt das Video wirklich (Abspielpfad-Variante ohne Blob-Vorladen, Server-Fallback-Pfad)
checks.name: fishing-legendary-catch-video-fallback-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun FAILED first (stale selector: '[data-testid=...]:not(.invisible)' + video.locator('source') -- the overlay/video are no longer permanently mounted nor use a <source> child). Rewritten to use the plain testid (now unambiguous, only the active catch ever portal-mounts it) and video.getAttribute('src') directly; passed on rerun. Overlay visible, src is the mp4 path or a blob:, mid-video tap doesn't close it, Chromium (no H.264) falls back -> fishing-legendary-catch +250, overlay unmounted, reel/start called once each.
